extracted.intended_audience: Local artists, community members, and applicants preparing Lynn Cultural Council grant applications; attendees of the LynnCAM TV grant-writing workshop
extracted.subtask_description: A short community workshop/video segment that guides prospective applicants through filling out the Lynn Cultural Council (LCC) annual grant application and explains the council's activities and application process. Targeted at people in Lynn, MA seeking cultural/arts grant funding, with an annual application deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: LCC annual grant deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: The Lynn Cultural Council's annual grant has an annual deadline of October 15.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must submit their LCC grant applications by October 15 each year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Workshop instruction: filling out the LCC grant
rubrics_metrics.description: This workshop specifically would guide people through the process of filling out a grant for the LCC’s annual grant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The video/workshop is intended to walk applicants through completing the LCC application form; registration details were provided via Eventbrite and additional information at mass-culture.org/lynn.
